name: 41434-decodeheavy-0.6b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, `--distributed-executor-backend uni`; one in-process engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, rate unbounded, 408 bounded requests, 900 s safety cap, no cooldown. Warmup is declared at 6% (24 requests), but 24 is below the 32 streams in flight, so the boundary lands at t~0 and the scored population is all 408.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 256 prompt and 2048 output tokens with min = max on both, prompts drawn independently, seed 1. On the wire the prompt reads 264 tokens, because the `vllm_python` backend renders each row as a chat message and applies the template; that backend also sets ignore_eos, so every request emits exactly 2048 tokens.
purpose: A small chat assistant that returns long multi-paragraph answers to brief prompts for 32 simultaneous users on a single GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B

# The engine logs a FlashAttention-2 override warning at startup for this kv-cache-dtype; expected.
kv-cache-dtype: turboquant_k8v4

tensor-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: uni

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
